items.title_zh: 意大利铸造业协会称欧盟钢铁配额和CBAM造成上下游成本不对称
items.title_en: Italian foundry association says EU steel quotas and CBAM create an upstream-downstream cost asymmetry
items.title_original: Steel: Confimi’s Italian foundries take on Brussels – tariffs and the CBAM are hurting the supply chain
items.summary_zh: Eunews完整报道及Confimi Industria Meccanica声明称，参加帕多瓦会议的铸造和机械企业中“近30%”出现订单下降；协会认为，原材料钢进口超过欧盟配额后承担50%从价税，而部分半成品、铸件和下游部件未受到同等贸易防御或CBAM约束，造成成本不对称。协会主席Flavio Lorenzin还称，自2025年11月以来，碳钢、不锈钢和铝成本平均分别上升13%、16%和37%，并要求调整进口税、能源和监管成本，同时在CBAM谈判中纳入半成品、铸件和部件。官方交叉核对确认：Regulation (EU) 2026/1384自2026年7月1日起实施18.3百万吨年度免税配额及配额外50%税率；CBAM下游扩围仍是2025/0419(COD)立法提案，不能把协会诉求写成已通过规则。
items.summary_en: Eunews and Confimi Industria Meccanica report that nearly 30% of foundry and engineering companies represented at a Padua event had lost orders. The association argues that the 50% out-of-quota steel duty and CBAM leave some semi-finished goods, castings and components outside equivalent treatment, creating a cost asymmetry. It cites average cost increases since November 2025 of 13% for carbon steel, 16% for stainless steel and 37% for aluminium. Official checks confirm that Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 applies an 18.3Mt annual quota and 50% out-of-quota duty from 1 July 2026; downstream CBAM expansion remains proposal 2025/0419(COD), not adopted law.
items.impact_zh: 这是意大利行业协会的调查和政策立场，不是欧盟对损失订单、成本涨幅或扩围范围的官方认定。对中国钢厂而言，现行钢铁配额外50%税率已构成实际市场准入约束；同时，若未来CBAM扩大到更多下游制成品，原材料与部件之间的成本差可能收窄。出口商应按CN产品类别和配额余额核价，并跟踪2025/0419(COD)最终附件；不能根据协会发言预设半成品或部件已纳入CBAM。
items.impact_en: This is an association survey and policy position, not an EU finding on lost orders, cost inflation or final CBAM scope. Chinese exporters already face the 50% out-of-quota steel duty where quotas are exhausted. They should price by CN category and quota balance and monitor the final annex to 2025/0419(COD), without assuming downstream goods are already covered.
items.source_excerpt: Steel: Confimi’s Italian foundries take on Brussels – tariffs and the CBAM are hurting the supply chain Eunews
items.follow_up: 跟踪2025/0419(COD)三方谈判及最终CN附件，并核对欧盟各钢铁产品配额余额；协会所称订单和成本数据仅作行业样本信号。
items.coverage: 2026-10-31已通读Eunews英文全文并核对Confimi原始声明摘要；另以Regulation (EU) 2026/1384、Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1457及EUR-Lex程序2025/0419(COD)核对50%配额外税率和CBAM扩围法律状态。未获得“近30%”及13%/16%/37%的样本量、计算方法或企业明细，故只按协会陈述呈现。

items.title_zh: 港口库存升至1.5372亿吨，铁矿石期货跌破680元／吨
items.title_en: Iron ore futures fall below CNY 680/t as port stocks reach 153.72Mt
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Lows on Rising China Port Stocks, Weak Mill Profitability
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 10月30日市场简报称，铁矿石期货跌破680元／吨、接近四年低位；其引用的行业数据称，中国主要港口库存周环比增加近1%至1.5372亿吨，澳大利亚和巴西以外生产国发运维持高位，钢厂盈利比例为11.26%、与前一周持平。北方部分省份环保限制继续压低铁水产量，但限制解除后可能恢复；淡水河谷另报第三季度核心利润下降20%，归因于矿价走低及燃料、运费成本偏高。该文是即时市场报道，价格、库存和盈利比例并非官方统计序列。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reported on 30 October that iron ore futures fell below CNY 680/t toward four-year lows. Cited industry data put major Chinese port stocks at 153.72Mt, up nearly 1% week on week, and the share of profitable steel mills at 11.26%, unchanged. Environmental curbs constrained hot-metal output in northern provinces, while Vale reported a 20% fall in third-quarter core profit. These are market-series figures, not official statistics.
items.impact_zh: 库存增加和低盈利比例说明矿价反弹基础仍弱，但单日价格不能直接证明钢厂利润将改善或必须减产。钢厂应同时看焦煤、焦炭、成材价格、库存结构和到港节奏，按采购窗口管理原料风险；贸易商应标明期货合约、交割月份和数据来源，避免把“接近四年低位”当作长期价格底部。
items.impact_en: Higher stocks and a low profitable-mill ratio point to weak support, but a one-day futures move does not prove margins will recover or mills must cut output. Mills should assess coking coal, coke, finished-steel prices, stock composition and arrivals together, and traders should identify the contract and data source rather than treat a near-four-year low as a durable floor.
items.source_excerpt: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Lows on Rising China Port Stocks, Weak Mill Profitability - News and Statistics IndexBox
items.follow_up: 跟踪后续港口库存、到港量、铁水产量及钢厂盈利比例；价格结论仅适用于报道时点。
items.coverage: 2026-10-31已通读IndexBox公开全文，核对680元／吨、1.5372亿吨、近1%和11.26%等数字及淡水河谷表述；原始行业数据库和Trading Economics序列未逐笔审计，故按媒体引用的市场数据处理。

items.title_zh: 宝钢股份前三季度归母净利润67.39亿元，同比下降15.33%
items.title_en: Baosteel's nine-month net profit falls 15.33% to CNY 6.739bn
items.title_original: Baosteel’s net profit fell by 15.3% y/y in nine months
items.summary_zh: 宝钢股份2026年第三季度报告显示，第三季度营业收入849.16亿元、同比增长4.75%，归母净利润21.67亿元、同比下降29.67%，扣非归母净利润19.61亿元、同比下降40.50%；前三季度营业收入2456.48亿元、同比增长5.68%，归母净利润67.39亿元、同比下降15.33%，扣非归母净利润64.93亿元、同比下降19.20%。前三季度铁产量3660.5万吨、钢产量3863.2万吨、商品坯材销量3915.0万吨、合并利润86.1亿元；出口接单量587.3万吨，同比增加70.4万吨。公司称单位铁水、物流、能源及质量成本同口径分别下降3%、6%、4%和16%。财务报表未经审计。
items.summary_en: Baosteel's unaudited third-quarter report shows Q3 revenue of CNY 84.916bn (+4.75% y/y), attributable net profit of CNY 2.167bn (-29.67%) and adjusted attributable profit of CNY 1.961bn (-40.50%). For January–September, revenue was CNY 245.648bn (+5.68%), attributable net profit CNY 6.739bn (-15.33%) and adjusted profit CNY 6.493bn (-19.20%). Nine-month steel output was 38.632Mt, saleable billet and product sales 39.150Mt, consolidated profit CNY 8.61bn, and export orders 5.873Mt, up 0.704Mt.
items.impact_zh: 收入增长但利润下降，说明吨钢盈利仍受钢价、原燃料及结构因素挤压；与此同时，产销量和出口接单增长并不支持简单推断宝钢正在减产。采购方和竞争对手应把5.873百万吨出口接单视为公司口径的订单量，而非已报关出口量，并继续跟踪第四季度交付、价格和库存。成本改善是公司披露的同口径指标，不能替代外部审计或推导单个产品利润。
items.impact_en: Revenue growth alongside lower profit indicates margin pressure, while higher output, sales and export orders do not support a simple production-cut conclusion. Treat the 5.873Mt figure as company-reported export orders, not customs-cleared exports, and monitor Q4 delivery, pricing and stocks. Company cost-improvement metrics are not an audit of product-level margins.

items.coverage: 2026-10-31已通读上海证券报所载宝钢股份2026年第三季度报告及主要经营数据公告，核对收入、归母净利润、扣非净利润、产销量、出口接单和成本指标；报告明确为未经审计，未核验订单级出口目的地和产品结构。

items.title_zh: 中钢协：前三季度钢铁供强需弱、库存高位，重点企业利润下降27.4%
items.title_en: CISA says nine-month steel supply outpaced demand as key-member profits fell 27.4%
items.title_original: 【新华解读】供需失衡、成本上涨 钢铁行业低利润运行
items.summary_zh: 新华财经对中钢协三季度信息发布会的完整报道显示，2026年前三季度全国粗钢产量7.25亿吨、同比下降2.9%，折合粗钢表观消费量6.25亿吨、下降3.8%；钢材出口8564万吨、下降2.6%，出口均价709美元／吨、上升1.8%。重点统计企业平均钢材库存1685万吨，为近四年最高；CSPI平均92.28点、同比下降1.48%，为近十年同期最低。重点企业营业收入4.57万亿元、下降2.3%，营业成本4.29万亿元、下降1.9%，利润总额718亿元、下降27.4%。炼焦煤、冶金焦、喷吹煤和国产铁精矿采购成本分别上涨20.45%、16.66%、16.06%和0.15%，进口粉矿下降1.31%。中钢协副会长唐祖君称行业主要矛盾仍是供强需弱，并倡导“以销定产、以效定产、以现定销”。
items.summary_en: Xinhua Finance's full report on CISA's Q3 briefing says January–September crude-steel output was 725Mt (-2.9%), apparent crude-steel consumption 625Mt (-3.8%), steel exports 85.64Mt (-2.6%) and average export price USD 709/t (+1.8%). Key-member average finished-steel stocks were 16.85Mt, the highest in four years, while the average CSPI was 92.28, the lowest comparable level in a decade. Key members reported CNY 4.57tn revenue (-2.3%) and CNY 71.8bn total profit (-27.4%). Coking-coal, coke and PCI-coal purchase costs rose 20.45%, 16.66% and 16.06%.
items.impact_zh: 需求降幅大于产量降幅、库存高位和焦煤焦炭成本上升共同压缩利润，出口量下降但出口均价回升，不能只凭出口均价判断盈利改善。钢厂应按订单、现金回款和边际贡献落实动态产销平衡，控制成品库存与高成本原料敞口；出口部门应继续按目的国贸易救济、配额和CBAM要求筛选订单。协会“三定三不要”属于行业自律和经营倡议，不是行政限产或新的出口配额。
items.impact_en: Consumption fell faster than output, high stocks and higher coal/coke costs squeezed margins, while a higher average export price does not prove better profitability. Mills should align output with orders, cash collection and marginal contribution, manage finished-goods and raw-material exposure, and screen exports for trade remedies, quotas and CBAM. CISA's operating principles are industry guidance, not an administrative production cut or export quota.

items.title_zh: 欧英不锈钢进口配额趋紧：部分配额已用尽，英国CBAM默认值将放大数据不足成本
items.title_en: EU and UK stainless quotas tighten; UK CBAM defaults raise the cost of missing data
items.title_original: EU & UK Stainless Steel Quotas Tighten: Higher Tariffs, CBAM Costs Ahead
items.summary_zh: MEPS对2026年第四季度配额使用情况的分析显示，欧盟不锈钢棒及轻型材的“其他国家”溢出配额2,399吨已用尽，截至10月15日超额申请14,858吨；印度国别配额23,139吨也已用尽，而中国、日本和韩国国别配额尚有余额。欧盟无缝不锈钢管的FTA/国别溢出配额亦超额申请逾750吨，印度3,832吨和“其他国家”774吨配额已用尽。英国方面，截至10月15日，欧盟来源不锈钢棒及轻型材4,135吨配额约78%尚未使用，但其他来源棒材/轻型材590吨和盘条59吨已用尽；土耳其“其他焊管”第四季度3,629吨配额已用尽。英欧自7月1日起缩减钢铁配额并将超额税率提高至50%。MEPS按英国官方示例税率£9.69/tCO₂e测算，部分冷轧不锈钢默认值5.347—6.746 tCO₂e/t对应约£51.81—£65.36/t；这只是示例税率乘默认值的情景，不是正式2027年应缴税额。英国首季正式CBAM税率仍须在2026年底前发布。
items.summary_en: MEPS reports that the EU's 2,399t overflow quota for stainless bars and light sections was exhausted and over-allocated by 14,858t by 15 October; India's 23,139t country quota was also exhausted, while China, Japan and Korea still had balances. EU seamless stainless tube overflow and India/other-country quotas were likewise exhausted. In the UK, about 78% of the 4,135t EU quota for stainless bars and light sections remained, but small residual quotas and Türkiye's 3,629t other-welded-tube quota were exhausted. MEPS multiplies official UK default values by the illustrative £9.69/tCO2e rate to show roughly £51.81–£65.36/t for certain cold-rolled stainless products. This is a scenario, not the official 2027 liability.
items.impact_zh: 中国不锈钢出口商不能只看50%超额税率，应按目的市场、产品类别、原产地和到港季度逐票核对配额余额；中国国别配额尚有余额不等于所有不锈钢品类均可免税。对英订单应立即向客户提供8位CN编码、净重、生产装置和可核证实际排放，并在合同中明确配额用尽、CBAM默认值、核查费及碳价减免的承担方。缺少实际排放数据时，英国进口商可用默认值，但由此测算的成本可能高于企业实际排放；正式报价须等待季度正式税率并核对具体编码，不能把£51.81—£65.36/t直接套用于所有产品。
items.impact_en: Check quota balances by market, product category, origin and arrival quarter; remaining China-specific balances do not cover every stainless product. For UK orders, provide the eight-digit CN code, net mass, installation and verifiable actual emissions, and allocate quota, default-value, verification and carbon-price-relief risks in contracts. Do not apply the modelled £51.81–£65.36/t universally; use the official quarterly rate and product code.

items.title_zh: 英国更新2021—2026年UK ETS装置免费配额表，部分2026年数值仍在复核
items.title_en: UK updates its 2021–2026 installation free-allocation table; some 2026 figures remain under review
items.title_original: UK ETS Allocation Table for operators of installations
items.summary_zh: 英国UK ETS主管机构于2026年10月30日更新装置运营商免费配额表，调整源于活动水平变化。表格覆盖2021—2026配额期；2026年按现有配额期延长一年处理。首次在2026年获得免费配额、或因发电设施规则变化而新增合格子装置的运营商，使用已核证的2023年活动数据确定2026年配额。已加入2026—2030年医院及小排放设施或超小排放设施名单的原免费配额接收者，2026年不再获得免费配额。部分2026年Standard (A)和NER (B)栏故意留空、只列Total (C)，表示其总量仍可能因2025年活动水平变化程序调整。
items.summary_en: On 30 October 2026 the UK ETS Authority updated the installation allocation table for activity-level changes. The table covers 2021–2026, with 2026 treated as an extension of the current period. Verified 2023 activity data determine 2026 allocations for first-time recipients and newly eligible sub-installations. Operators moving to the 2026–2030 Hospital and Small Emitter or Ultra-Small Emitter lists receive no free allocation in 2026. Blank Standard (A) and NER (B) cells with only Total (C) indicate figures still under review through the 2025 activity-level-change process.
items.impact_zh: 这不是英国CBAM税率表，也不直接给出中国钢材的进口税额；它反映英国同类装置获得的免费配额基础，相关变化可能影响英国生产者的有效碳成本和后续CBAM行业税率环境。对英出口企业应继续依据正式CBAM行业税率、默认值或核证实际排放报价，不能从单个英国装置的免费配额反推进口税负。英国客户和竞争分析可关注钢铁装置2026年Total (C)及后续复核结果。
items.impact_en: This is not a UK CBAM rate table and does not determine a Chinese shipment's tax. It records free allocation for UK installations and may affect domestic effective carbon costs and the broader CBAM rate environment. Exporters should use official sector rates, defaults or verified actual emissions rather than infer import tax from an individual installation's allocation.
items.source_excerpt: This table contains a list of each installation’s free allocation for the 2021 to 2026 allocation period. 30 October 2026 The allocation table has been updated with amendments to operators’ allowances as a result of Activity Level Changes. items.title_zh: 中国35港铁矿石库存升至1.4805亿吨，日均疏港量回落
items.title_en: China's 35-port iron ore stocks reach 148.05Mt as daily port pick-up slows
items.title_original: China Iron Ore Port Stocks Rise to 148.05 Million Tons as Demand Softens
items.summary_zh: SMM 10月30日数据显示，中国35个主要港口铁矿石库存为1.4805亿吨，环比增加30万吨；日均疏港量减少3.5万吨至317.5万吨。本周港口到货明显增加，而钢厂高炉铁水产量下降，下游采购偏谨慎，供需边际走弱并带来小幅累库。SMM预计下一周钢厂需求仍偏弱、铁水产量可能继续下降，疏港量难明显改善，港口库存或继续增加；这一段属于机构短期判断，不是已发生的确定结果。
items.summary_en: SMM data for 30 October put iron ore inventories across 35 major Chinese ports at 148.05Mt, up 0.30Mt on the reported comparison, while average daily port pick-up fell by 0.035Mt to 3.175Mt. Port arrivals rose notably during the week, blast-furnace hot-metal output declined and downstream purchasing remained cautious, producing a slight inventory build. SMM expects subdued mill demand, potentially lower hot-metal output and little improvement in port pick-up next week, but that is a short-term forecast rather than an observed outcome.
items.impact_zh: 35港口径的库存上升、疏港回落和铁水下降共同显示钢厂补库意愿偏弱，短期不利于铁矿石需求和价格支撑。钢厂可继续按生产节奏和边际利润安排刚需采购，贸易商应同步跟踪港口到货、钢厂利润、铁水复产及成材需求。该数据来自SMM模型和市场调研，并非海关或统计局官方数据；也不能与其他机构覆盖港口数量不同的库存口径直接比较。
items.impact_en: Rising stocks on SMM's 35-port measure, slower port pick-up and lower hot-metal output point to weak mill restocking and softer near-term support for ore demand and prices. Mills can keep procurement aligned with production and marginal profitability, while traders should monitor arrivals, mill margins, hot-metal restarts and finished-steel demand. These are SMM market-research data, not customs or official statistical data, and should not be compared directly with inventory series covering a different port universe.
items.source_excerpt: China Iron Ore Port Stocks Rise to 148.05 Million Tons as Demand Softens - News and Statistics IndexBox

items.follow_up: 下周复核SMM 35港库存、疏港量和铁水变化，并与其他机构口径分开记录。

items.title_zh: Fastmarkets：CBAM可能扩大高品位铁矿石价值差，核证数据优先于矿石品位优化
items.title_en: Fastmarkets: CBAM may widen high-grade iron ore value gap, but verified data comes first
items.title_original: How CBAM will widen the premium for high-grade iron ore
items.summary_zh: Fastmarkets建模认为，高品位矿可减少渣量、熔剂、焦炭或电耗及铁损，CBAM与欧盟ETS免费配额在2026—2038年逐步退出可能放大其价值。在其敏感性情景中，DRI-EAF由67.5% Fe球团改用65% Fe球团，2026年非碳成本约增加41欧元/吨热轧卷，到2035年约85欧元/吨；相应额外CBAM成本按其碳价和政策假设约由1欧元增至13欧元/吨。BF-BOF路线使用较低品位矿的额外排放约25千克CO₂/吨热轧卷，额外CBAM成本模型值约为2026年2欧元、2030年3欧元、2035年7欧元/吨。上述均为行业模型结果，不是欧盟法定加价或所有中国钢材的税额。欧盟官方规则确认：钢铁使用默认值时，2026、2027、2028年及以后分别加成10%、20%、30%。
items.summary_en: Fastmarkets models how higher-grade ore can reduce slag, fluxes, coke or electricity use and iron losses, with CBAM and the 2026–2038 phase-out of EU ETS free allocation potentially widening the value gap. Its DRI-EAF sensitivity puts the non-carbon penalty from switching 67.5% Fe pellets to 65% at about EUR41/t HRC in 2026 and EUR85/t by 2035, with additional modelled CBAM cost rising from about EUR1 to EUR13/t. For BF-BOF, it models roughly 25kg CO2/t HRC of extra emissions and additional CBAM cost of EUR2 in 2026, EUR3 in 2030 and EUR7 in 2035. These are model outputs, not statutory EU surcharges or universal China rates. Official EU rules apply default-value mark-ups of 10% in 2026, 20% in 2027 and 30% from 2028 for iron and steel.
items.impact_zh: 对中国高炉—转炉及DRI/EAF钢厂，第一优先不是为CBAM盲目追高品位矿，而是取得欧盟可接受的装置级及产品级实际排放核证；使用默认值时，企业自身的矿石优化不会直接反映在申报排放值中。完成核证后，再把矿价、成材率、渣量、焦比或电耗、实际排放、EU ETS价格和合同责任纳入同一测算。文中的2、7、13、41和85欧元/吨均不能直接套用于首钢或任何具体订单。
items.impact_en: For Chinese BF-BOF and DRI/EAF producers, securing acceptable verified installation and product emissions data comes before paying blindly for higher-grade ore. If defaults are used, a producer's own ore optimisation is not reflected directly in the declared value. After verification, compare ore premiums against yield, slag, coke or electricity use, actual emissions, ETS prices and contractual responsibility. The article's EUR figures cannot be applied directly to a specific mill or order.

items.coverage: 2026-10-30已通读Fastmarkets全文，核对两条工艺路线、矿石品位、成本与排放敏感性数字；并对照欧委会CBAM立法指南、实施条例(EU) 2025/2621（经(EU) 2026/1740修正）及欧盟气候行动页面核实默认值加成和2026—2038免费配额退出区间。未独立审计Fastmarkets模型底稿、矿价和碳价假设，所有前瞻数字均按情景而非确定税额处理。
items.follow_up: 继续跟踪欧委会对默认值、基准值、核证方法及免费配额调整的正式修订；如模型假设或欧盟法规变化，按新版本重算，不能沿用本文情景值。

items.title_zh: 首钢股份三季度转亏：前三季归母净利同比下降69.87%，采购现金支出增加
items.title_en: Beijing Shougang swings to a Q3 loss; nine-month attributable profit falls 69.87%
items.title_original: Beijing Shougang Co : Q3 swung to a net loss as weaker steel profitability drove sharp YTD earnings and cash-flow declines
items.summary_zh: 首钢股份正式发布2026年第三季度报告（未经审计）。第三季度营业收入248.34亿元，同比增加0.36%；归母净亏损2.61亿元，上年同期经重述为盈利2.99亿元；扣非净亏损2.55亿元。前三季营业收入757.54亿元，同比下降2.04%；归母净利润2.89亿元，同比下降69.87%；扣非净利润2.69亿元，同比下降72.80%；经营活动现金流净额11.22亿元，同比下降79.55%。公司称利润下滑主要因钢材产品吨钢利润及参股企业盈利水平降低；经营现金流下滑主要因支持采购市场运作的现金支付增加，预付款增加还受煤、焦炭价格上涨影响。报告未披露新增产能、停产安排或出口计划。
items.summary_en: Beijing Shougang's unaudited Q3 2026 report shows quarterly revenue of RMB24.834bn, up 0.36%, and an attributable net loss of RMB260.7m versus a restated RMB298.9m profit a year earlier. Nine-month revenue fell 2.04% to RMB75.754bn; attributable profit fell 69.87% to RMB288.9m, adjusted profit fell 72.80% to RMB268.8m, and operating cash flow fell 79.55% to RMB1.122bn. The company cited lower per-ton steel profitability and investee earnings, while higher procurement-related cash payments reduced operating cash flow. The report discloses no new capacity, shutdown or export plan.
items.impact_zh: 这是主要钢企经营信号，不是贸易政策。中国钢厂和出口业务不应把单季亏损直接转化为确定的减产或涨价判断；应跟踪吨钢利润、煤焦成本、采购现金占用以及后续产销安排。涉及欧盟或其他海外订单，仍须按具体产品、合同、配额、贸易救济和CBAM成本独立报价。在公司披露产量、出口或供应策略前，不能据本报告推断供应收缩。
items.impact_en: This is a corporate operating signal, not a trade rule. Do not infer definite production cuts or price rises from one quarterly loss. Monitor per-ton margins, coal and coke costs, procurement cash use and later production/sales guidance, while pricing export orders by product, contract, quota, trade-remedy and CBAM exposure.

items.title_zh: 美国续行中国一次性钢瓶反倾销、反补贴令，10月14日起继续有效
items.title_en: US continues AD/CVD orders on Chinese non-refillable steel cylinders effective 14 October
items.title_original: Non-Refillable Steel Cylinders From the People's Republic of China: Continuation of Antidumping Duty Order and Countervailing Duty Order
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部根据其与USITC在首次五年日落复审中的肯定裁定，正式续行对中国一次性钢瓶的反倾销令A-570-126和反补贴令C-570-127，有效日期为2026年10月14日。范围包括符合或按照美国交通部Specification 39、加拿大39M或ISO 11118制造的焊接或钎焊便携式不可重复充装钢瓶，水容积300立方英寸（4.9升）至1526立方英寸（25升），可带或不带阀门/泄压装置、进口时可为空瓶；装压缩空气且符合描述的产品也包括。无缝一次性钢瓶明确排除。列示HTSUS 7311.00.0060、7311.00.0090，并可能从7310.29.0025、7310.29.0050进入，但书面范围优先。美国海关将继续按进口时有效税率收取反倾销和反补贴现金保证金；本通知没有公布一项适用于所有企业的新统一税率。
items.summary_en: Commerce has continued AD order A-570-126 and CVD order C-570-127 on non-refillable steel cylinders from China following affirmative Commerce and USITC sunset-review determinations, effective 14 October 2026. The scope covers specified welded or brazed portable cylinders of 4.9–25 litre water capacity made to USDOT 39, Transport Canada 39M or ISO 11118 requirements; seamless non-refillable cylinders are excluded. Listed HTSUS numbers are 7311.00.0060/0090 and potentially 7310.29.0025/0050, but the written scope controls. CBP will continue cash deposits at rates in effect on entry; the notice does not announce one new uniform rate.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢瓶生产商和出口商应立即按结构（焊接/钎焊或无缝）、容积、适用标准、是否带阀以及书面范围复核对美订单，不能仅凭HTS编码判断。报价和合同应沿用企业/组合在入境日适用的反倾销、反补贴保证金安排，并让美国进口商核对CBP指令；“续行”意味着现行令继续，不代表所有企业税率相同，也不应从本公告推算具体税额。
items.impact_en: Review US orders against construction, capacity, standards, valve configuration and the written scope, not HTS codes alone. Price using the producer/exporter combination and cash-deposit instructions applicable on entry; continuation does not create one uniform rate.

items.source_excerpt: As a result of the determinations by the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) and the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on non-refillable steel cylinders the People's Republic of China (China) would likely lead to the continuation or recurrence of dumping, countervailable subsidies, and material injury to an industry in the United States, Commerce is publishing a notice of continuation of these AD and CVD orders.

items.title_zh: 美国加速审查中俄乌定尺碳钢板措施：书面意见11月30日截止
items.title_en: US expedites reviews of CTL carbon steel plate measures; comments due 30 November
items.title_original: Cut-to-Length Carbon Steel Plate From China, Russia, and Ukraine; Scheduling of Expedited Five-Year Reviews
items.summary_zh: 美国国际贸易委员会（USITC）在第五次日落复审中决定采用加速程序，审查撤销中国定尺碳钢板反倾销令，以及终止俄罗斯、乌克兰同类产品暂停调查安排，是否会在可预见期间导致美国国内产业实质损害延续或再现。公告称国内产业答复充分、被调查方答复不充分，未发现需要全面复审的其他情形；案件被认定为“特别复杂”，复审期可延长最多90天。非公开工作人员报告拟于2026年11月23日提供给行政保护令名单人员，公开版随后发布；具备资格的当事方书面意见及非当事公众简短陈述原则上于11月30日17:15（美国东部时间）前提交，且不得加入新的事实资料。这是USITC程序安排，不是新税率或撤销措施决定。
items.summary_en: USITC has scheduled expedited fifth sunset reviews of the Chinese CTL carbon steel plate antidumping order and the suspended investigations concerning Russia and Ukraine. Domestic responses were adequate and respondent responses inadequate; the reviews were deemed extraordinarily complicated, permitting an extension of up to 90 days. The non-public staff report is scheduled for 23 November 2026 and eligible written comments are due by 5:15 p.m. ET on 30 November, without new factual information. This is a procedural notice, not a new duty rate or revocation decision.
items.impact_zh: 涉及对美定尺碳钢板业务的中国生产商、出口商和进口商不应把“加速审查”理解为现行反倾销令已经撤销或加税。应由美国案件律师核对当事方资格、行政保护令服务名单、书面意见权限及11月30日提交时限，并按书面产品范围判断具体货物；HTS编码只能辅助，不能替代范围描述。未参与前期答复的主体可能不具备提交评论资格，须逐案确认。
items.impact_en: Do not treat the expedited review as revocation or a new duty. Counsel should verify party eligibility, APO service-list status, filing rights and the 30 November deadline, and assess merchandise against the written scope rather than tariff codes alone.

items.source_excerpt: The Commission hereby gives notice of the scheduling of expedited reviews pursuant to the Tariff Act of 1930 ("the Act") to determine whether revocation of the antidumping duty order on cut-to- length carbon steel plate from China and the termination of the suspended investigations on cut-to-length carbon steel plate from Russia and Ukraine would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury within a reasonably foreseeable time.

items.title_zh: LME上线以上期所热轧卷板结算价为基准的美元现金结算合约
items.title_en: LME launches USD cash-settled Shanghai hot-rolled coil contract linked to SHFE settlement prices
items.title_original: “LME上海热轧卷板合约”正式上市交易 “上海价格”国际应用场景进一步扩展
items.summary_zh: 上海国际能源交易中心10月29日披露，伦敦金属交易所（LME）已于10月27日上线以上海期货交易所热轧卷板期货结算价为基准的合约。合约代码HS，每手10吨，以美元／吨报价并采用现金结算，提供连续12个月的月度合约；到期结算价以上期所热轧卷板期货次月到期合约在LME合约到期日的结算价为基础，按中国外汇交易中心公布的美元兑人民币中间价换算。LME提供的数据显示，上市首日截至伦敦时间18:00，LMEselect成交880手，叠加办公室交易后当日清算总成交量2513手。
items.summary_en: The Shanghai International Energy Exchange reported on 29 October that the London Metal Exchange launched a contract on 27 October using the Shanghai Futures Exchange hot-rolled coil futures settlement price as its reference. Contract HS is quoted in USD per tonne, cash settled, sized at 10 tonnes per lot and offered in 12 consecutive monthly maturities. Its final settlement is based on the SHFE HRC contract expiring in the following month on the LME expiry date, converted using the CFETS USD/CNY central parity rate. LME data cited by the official release showed 880 lots traded on LMEselect and 2,513 lots cleared in total by 18:00 London time on launch day.
items.impact_zh: 这是交易和风险管理工具上线，不是钢材关税、出口政策或现货指导价。以美元报价中国热卷的钢厂和贸易商可评估其用于订单定价参考或跨市场套保，但现金结算意味着它不能替代实物交割安排，也不能消除人民币／美元换算、上期所与出口现货之间的基差风险。实际使用前应核对经纪商接入、保证金、流动性、结算汇率时点和企业内部套保授权，先以小规模头寸验证套保相关性。
items.impact_en: This is a new trading and risk-management instrument, not a steel tariff, export policy or official spot-price directive. Mills and traders quoting Chinese HRC in US dollars may assess it as a pricing reference or cross-market hedge, but cash settlement does not replace physical-delivery arrangements or remove FX and SHFE-versus-export-spot basis risk. Before use, firms should check broker access, margin, liquidity, the FX conversion timing and internal hedge mandates, and validate hedge correlation with small positions.

items.title_en: Shougang Jingtang plans September 2027 startup for No. 2 slab-caster revamp
items.title_original: Shougang Jingtang selects Primetals for slab caster revamp to improve automotive steel quality
items.summary_zh: Primetals Technologies 10月29日公告称，首钢京唐选择其对河北曹妃甸基地2号双流板坯连铸机实施全面改造，目标是提高汽车钢板坯中心质量、后续轧制质量、浇铸速度和生产率，计划于2027年9月投运。项目包括DynaGap Soft Reduction、LevCon结晶器液位控制、带水平段干式浇铸能力的新导向段、EcoStar Spiral辊及Level 1/Level 2自动化系统。现有设备半径9.5米，冶金长度39.5米、未来可延长至44.26米；板坯规格250毫米×1100—2150毫米，最高浇铸速度1.7米／分钟。公告未披露合同金额、改造后年产能或确定的新增产量。
items.summary_en: Primetals Technologies said on 29 October that Shougang Jingtang selected it for a comprehensive revamp of the No. 2 two-strand slab caster at Caofeidian, with startup scheduled for September 2027. The project adds DynaGap Soft Reduction, LevCon mold-level control, a new strand guide with horizontal dry casting, EcoStar Spiral rolls and new Level 1/2 automation. Existing specifications include a 9.5m radius, 39.5m metallurgical length (44.26m future extension), 250mm by 1,100–2,150mm slabs and speeds up to 1.7m/min. No contract value or post-revamp annual capacity was disclosed.
items.impact_zh: 改造重点是汽车钢板坯质量和过程稳定性，可能提升首钢京唐在汽车外板、内板等高附加值产品上的成材率和一致性，但公告不足以证明新增产能或2027年前供应量变化。汽车钢采购方可在2027年投运和认证阶段关注质量指标、客户验证及爬坡进度；竞争分析不得把设备最高速度或未来冶金长度直接换算成年产量。
items.impact_en: The revamp targets slab quality and process stability for automotive grades and may improve yield and consistency, but the release does not establish added capacity or near-term supply changes. Buyers should monitor commissioning, customer qualification and ramp-up in 2027; equipment speed and metallurgical length should not be converted directly into annual output.

items.title_zh: 印度学者建议为中小企业建立英欧CBAM编码、排放核算与核证支持体系
items.title_en: Indian policy commentary calls for SME support on UK and EU CBAM data and verification
items.title_original: CBAM: Let's get ready
items.summary_zh: 印度贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学学者Amita Batra的评论认为，英欧CBAM对中小出口企业的主要障碍是商品编码映射、供应链排放计量、核证能力和碳价减免证明，建议政府或行业协会提供基础设施、培训、技术和融资支持。经官方交叉核对：英国CBAM将于2027年1月1日覆盖铝、水泥、化肥、氢、钢铁；印度CCTS列入英国现行合格碳定价机制清单，但减免仍取决于实际应付碳价及合格证据；间接排放最早到2029年才纳入。英国法规要求核查机构独立并由合格认可机构认可，文章将“Global Accreditation Cooperation正式成员”的要求直接写到核查人员身上并不准确。欧盟证书自2027年2月起购买，首份2026年度申报和证书清缴截止2027年9月30日。文中“180多种下游产品拟扩围”属于政策进程表述，不代表已经纳入现行范围。
items.summary_en: Amita Batra argues that SMEs need public or industry support for product-code mapping, value-chain emissions measurement, verification, finance and training. Official checks confirm that UK CBAM starts on 1 January 2027 and India's CCTS is on the qualifying carbon-pricing list, but relief still depends on actual payable carbon costs and evidence. Indirect emissions are delayed until at least 2029. The article conflates verifier and accreditation-body eligibility: UK law requires an independent verifier accredited by an eligible accreditation body. EU certificates go on sale from February 2027 and the first 2026 declaration/surrender deadline is 30 September 2027. Proposed downstream expansion is not current scope.
items.impact_zh: 对中国中小钢企同样适用的动作是：先按英欧各自8位编码建立产品清单，将工厂、工艺、前体材料、排放年度和客户逐项映射；再选择认可范围覆盖相应钢铁活动的核查机构，并保存境外碳价实际支付证明。英国与欧盟的口径、期限和减免机制不能混成一套模板。行业评论可作为能力建设建议，但不应据此认定中国ETS已自动获得英国减免、欧盟已完成扩围，或某一核查人员天然合格。
items.impact_en: Chinese SMEs should build separate UK and EU code maps, link products to installations, processes, precursors and reporting years, appoint verifiers with the correct steel scope, and retain evidence of carbon prices actually paid. Do not assume automatic relief, completed EU scope expansion or universal verifier eligibility from this commentary.

items.title_zh: 英国就将炼油产品纳入CBAM征求意见，反馈截止2027年1月20日
items.title_en: UK consults on adding refinery products to CBAM; responses due 20 January 2027
items.title_original: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM): a consultation on sectoral scope expansion to include refinery products
items.summary_zh: 英国财政部与税务海关总署发布开放咨询，拟在技术可行后尽快把部分炼油产品纳入英国CBAM；这不是已生效扩围，实施时间尚未确定。文件建议初期覆盖15个8位商品编码下的汽油、柴油、航空煤油和煤油：2710 1225、2710 1231、2710 1241、2710 1245、2710 1249、2710 1250、2710 1270、2710 1290、2710 1921、2710 1925、2710 1929、2710 1944、2710 1946、2710 1947、2710 1948；同时征询是否初期排除乙醇和FAME等低碳燃料，并按质量平衡扣除混合燃料中的低碳部分。拟议方法包括装置级统一强度、装置级重新分配以及生产过程级核算；氢可能作为前体计入。炼油产品默认值、原产炼厂/国家证明、行业税率及碳价减免仍待决定。咨询于2027年1月20日23:59截止。
items.summary_en: HM Treasury and HMRC opened a consultation on adding a subset of refinery products to UK CBAM as soon as feasible; no implementation date has been set and the scope expansion is not yet law. The proposal tests 15 eight-digit commodity codes covering petrol, diesel, jet fuel and kerosene: 2710 1225, 2710 1231, 2710 1241, 2710 1245, 2710 1249, 2710 1250, 2710 1270, 2710 1290, 2710 1921, 2710 1925, 2710 1929, 2710 1944, 2710 1946, 2710 1947 and 2710 1948. It asks whether neat low-carbon fuels such as ethanol and FAME should initially be excluded, with mass-balance treatment for blends. Installation-level and process-level emissions methods, hydrogen as a precursor, defaults, origin evidence, a refining-sector rate and carbon-price relief remain under consultation. Responses close at 11:59pm on 20 January 2027.
items.impact_zh: 本咨询不改变2027年起已覆盖钢铁的英国CBAM范围、钢铁税率或申报义务；对中国钢企的直接合规工作仍应按现行钢铁规则推进。间接影响可能来自英国物流、燃料和供应链成本，炼油方法也可能成为未来其他行业扩围的参考。集团如同时向英国出口成品油、经营贸易/仓储或掌握炼厂排放与原产追溯数据，应在2027年1月20日23:59前提交对商品编码、混合燃料质量平衡、炼厂追溯、默认值和成本传导的证据；不能据咨询稿预估确定税额。
items.impact_en: The consultation does not change the existing UK CBAM scope, rate or compliance duties for iron and steel from 2027. Steel exporters should continue preparing under the enacted steel rules. Indirect effects may arise through UK fuel, logistics and supply-chain costs, and the refinery methodology may inform later scope expansion. Groups that also export refined fuels, trade or store them, or hold refinery emissions/origin data should submit evidence on codes, blend mass balance, refinery traceability, defaults and cost pass-through by 11:59pm on 20 January 2027. Do not price a definite charge from this consultation.

items.title_zh: 中国钢材出口仍处高位、贸易救济增多：调查、裁决与已征税须逐案区分
items.title_en: China’s steel exports remain high as trade remedies rise; case status must be checked individually
items.title_original: 中国钢材出口遇难，20多国接连设限，钢铁行业进入寒冬
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇市场评论，不是政府措施或新的贸易救济决定。文章所引核心外贸数据可核对：2025年中国出口钢材11901.9万吨，同比增长7.5%，出口均价约693.8美元/吨、同比下降8.2%；2026年1—9月累计出口8564.1万吨，同比下降2.6%。文中“20多个国家和地区、98起贸易救济案件”可追溯至Mysteel依据中国贸易救济信息网公开记录所作的不完全汇总，其中混合了调查、裁决等不同节点，并非商务部发布的一项官方汇总统计，更不能理解为98项已经生效的新税。文章同时指出，发起调查不等于已经认定倾销或开始征税，这一区分是正确的；其关于行业“寒冬”和转型路径的表述属于作者判断。
items.summary_en: This is market commentary, not a government measure or a new trade-remedy decision. Core trade data can be cross-checked: China exported 119.019 million tonnes of steel products in 2025, up 7.5%, at an average price of about USD 693.8 per tonne, down 8.2%; exports in January–September 2026 were 85.641 million tonnes, down 2.6%. The claim of 98 trade-remedy cases across more than 20 jurisdictions traces to a Mysteel incomplete aggregation of public China Trade Remedies Information records. It combines investigations and determinations at different stages, is not a single official MOFCOM aggregate release, and does not mean 98 new duties are in force. The article correctly distinguishes initiation from a dumping finding or an effective duty; its broader “winter” and transformation narrative is commentary.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂和出口商不应把“98起”当作统一税负或市场关闭程度。实务上应建立按国家／地区、产品、HS税号、生产商—出口商组合、案件编号和法律阶段管理的台账，分别标注立案、初裁、临时措施、终裁、期终复审、保障措施及生效日期；报价前逐案核对税率、保证金、配额、原产地及熔炼浇铸证据。高端化和海外加工可以改善产品与市场结构，但境外加工并不会自动改变原产地或规避反规避审查，不能据评论稿直接调整税率、合同或投资判断。
items.impact_en: Chinese mills and exporters should not treat “98 cases” as a uniform tariff burden or a measure of market closure. Maintain a case matrix by jurisdiction, product, HS code, producer-exporter combination, case number and legal stage, separating initiation, preliminary determination, provisional measures, final measures, reviews, safeguards and effective dates. Before quoting, verify the applicable rate, deposits, quotas, origin and melt-and-pour evidence case by case. Higher-value products and overseas processing may improve market positioning, but foreign processing does not automatically change origin or avoid anti-circumvention scrutiny.

items.title_original: Japan to Impose Anti-Dumping Duties of Up to 42.1% on Chinese, Taiwanese Stainless Steel Plate for 5 Years from Oct. 31
items.summary_zh: 日本财务省10月27日宣布，内阁已决定对原产于或从中国、台湾出口的镍系冷轧不锈钢带及冷轧板征收最终反倾销税；政令拟于10月30日公布，课税期为2026年10月31日至2031年10月30日。调查范围为含铬10.5%以上、镍0.6%以上的合金钢，涉及HS 7219.31—7219.35、7219.90、7220.20及7220.90项下22个税目。中国山西太钢及未抽样合作企业税率为27.7%，浦项（张家港）不锈钢（PZSS）及其他供应商为42.1%；台湾YUSCO及未抽样企业为3.6%，Walsin及其他供应商为20.1%。最终税率与7月9日起的临时税率相同。
items.summary_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance announced on 27 October that the Cabinet had decided definitive anti-dumping duties on nickel-added cold-rolled stainless steel coil, sheet and strip originating in or exported from China and Taiwan. The Cabinet Order is due to be promulgated on 30 October and duties will apply from 31 October 2026 through 30 October 2031. Scope covers alloy steel with at least 10.5% chromium and more than 0.6% nickel under 22 tariff lines within HS 7219.31-7219.35, 7219.90, 7220.20 and 7220.90. Rates are 27.7% for Shanxi Taigang and cooperating non-sampled Chinese suppliers, 42.1% for PZSS and other Chinese suppliers, 3.6% for YUSCO and cooperating non-sampled Taiwanese suppliers, and 20.1% for Walsin and other Taiwanese suppliers. These rates are unchanged from the provisional measure.
items.impact_zh: 这是已由日本内阁决定、即将公布并按明确日期实施的最终措施，不是提案。向日本出口相关冷轧不锈钢的中国钢厂和贸易商应在10月31日前按制造商身份、原产地/出口地和日本税目逐票复核适用税率；尤其不要把27.7%合作税率误用于PZSS或未获该待遇的供应商。报价和合同应明确反倾销税承担、在途货物清关日期及错误归类风险，并保存材质成分、宽度、轧制状态、制造商和原产地证明。该措施仅覆盖上述镍系冷轧不锈钢范围，不能外推到所有不锈钢板材。
items.impact_en: This is a definitive measure decided by Japan's Cabinet with a specified implementation date, not a proposal. Chinese mills and traders shipping covered cold-rolled stainless steel to Japan should verify the producer, origin/export route and Japanese tariff classification shipment by shipment before 31 October. Do not apply the 27.7% cooperating rate to PZSS or suppliers not entitled to it. Contracts and quotations should allocate anti-dumping duty, customs-clearance timing and misclassification risk, while retaining composition, width, rolling condition, producer and origin evidence. The measure covers the specified nickel-added cold-rolled products only, not all stainless plate.
items.status: 最终反倾销措施／10月31日起实施

items.title_zh: 中国钢厂盈利走弱，铁矿石期货逼近四年低位
items.title_en: Iron ore futures near four-year lows as Chinese mill profitability weakens
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Low on Weak Chinese Steel Demand
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 10月27日市场简报称，铁矿石期货周一跌向每吨670元人民币，接近四年低位；其引用的行业数据称，上周247家中国钢厂高炉开工率为80%，同比下降4.3%。同时，中国港口到货量偏高、全球发运增加，供应较充裕。报道还提到中国矿产资源集团与力拓达成新的供应安排，但具体条款未公开。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reported on 27 October that iron-ore futures moved toward CNY 670 per tonne on Monday, near four-year lows. It cited an 80% blast-furnace operating rate across 247 Chinese mills last week, down 4.3% year on year, alongside elevated port arrivals and rising global shipments. It also mentioned a new CMRG-Rio Tinto supply arrangement whose terms were not disclosed.
items.impact_zh: 这是市场信号，不是政策文件。原料价格下行有助于降低长流程钢厂采购成本，但其成因同时反映钢材需求和钢厂利润偏弱，不能据一日价格判断出口订单或利润已经改善。钢厂应分别跟踪现货矿价、钢材售价、库存和高炉利润；涉及中矿集团—力拓安排的采购判断，须等待双方可核实披露，不能把媒体所称口头通知当成公开合同条款。
items.impact_en: This is a market signal, not a policy measure. Lower ore prices can reduce blast-furnace input costs, but also reflect weak steel demand and mill margins; one day's price does not establish improved export profitability. Track spot ore, steel prices, inventories and furnace margins separately, and do not treat reported verbal notice of the CMRG-Rio Tinto arrangement as disclosed contract terms.
items.source_excerpt: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Low on Weak Chinese Steel Demand - News and Statistics IndexBox
items.coverage: 2026-10-27已通读IndexBox公开全文，核对670元/吨、247家钢厂、80%开工率、同比下降4.3%及供应描述；这些为媒体引用的市场数据，未独立取得交易所结算表或行业样本底稿。中矿集团—力拓协议条款未公开，未据此推断价格或数量。

items.title_zh: GMK称乌克兰CBAM损失已高于欧委会预测，主张重算影响评估
items.title_en: GMK says Ukraine's CBAM losses already exceed the Commission forecast and calls for a reassessment
items.title_original: CBAM for Ukraine: why the European Commission should revise its impact assessment
items.summary_zh: GMK Center 10月27日分析称，2026年上半年乌克兰对欧盟、覆盖全部CBAM钢铁编码的出口额同比减少1.49亿欧元；其把供应链效应计入后，估算相当于约0.3%的GDP损失。GMK还预计，扁平材平均CBAM支付可能由2026年的78欧元/吨升至2030年的198欧元/吨，长材由61欧元/吨升至173欧元/吨，并主张欧委会把战争破坏、停产、能源和物流约束纳入重新评估。上述数据和预测是GMK模型结果及政策主张，不是欧盟正式豁免或税率决定。欧委会正式报告的基准是到2035年GDP影响约负0.01%，并非GMK文中所写的2031年。
items.summary_en: GMK Center said on 27 October that the value of Ukrainian iron and steel exports to the EU across all CBAM-covered codes fell by EUR 149 million year on year in H1 2026; including supply-chain effects, it estimates a GDP loss of about 0.3%. GMK projects average CBAM payments rising from EUR 78/t in 2026 to EUR 198/t in 2030 for flat products and from EUR 61/t to EUR 173/t for long products, and calls on the Commission to reassess war damage, shutdowns, energy and logistics constraints. These are GMK modelling results and policy requests, not an EU exemption or tariff decision. The Commission's formal report states an estimated GDP effect of about -0.01% by 2035, not 2031 as written in GMK's article.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂的直接规则没有变化。该争议提示，第三国行业会以战争、发展水平和投资能力争取特殊或过渡安排；若乌克兰最终获得可执行优惠，可能改变其钢材在欧盟市场相对中国货源的竞争条件。但中国企业不能据此预期同等待遇，应继续准备经核查的产品级排放数据、测算不同EU ETS价格情景，并在DDP等合同中明确最终CBAM差额和核查失败风险。
items.impact_en: No rule for Chinese steel changes. The dispute shows that third-country industries may seek special or transitional treatment based on war damage, development level and investment capacity; any enforceable Ukraine-specific relief could alter its competitive position versus Chinese supply in the EU. Chinese firms should not assume comparable treatment and should continue preparing verified product-level emissions data, modelling ETS-price scenarios and allocating final CBAM and verification risks in DDP contracts.
items.status: 行业研究与政策主张／非欧盟决定
items.source_excerpt: CBAM for Ukraine: why the European Commission should revise its impact assessment GMK Center
items.coverage: 2026-10-27已通读GMK Center完整英文分析页，核对1.49亿欧元、约0.3% GDP、扁平材78→198欧元/吨、长材61→173欧元/吨及重算诉求；并通读GMK 2026年3月18页研究的核心假设、方法和情景，同时以欧委会COM(2025) 783正式报告核对官方基准。发现GMK本页把欧委会负0.01%预测年份写为2031年，而正式报告为2035年，已在摘要纠正。GMK模型中的企业排放强度并非排放方正式确认，未将其外推为中国产品税额。

follow_up.action_zh: 跟踪欧委会是否正式重开乌克兰CBAM影响评估，以及是否依据《CBAM条例》第30(7)条提出可执行的临时安排；在正式文本发布前不得假定豁免。
follow_up.action_en: Monitor whether the Commission formally reopens its Ukraine CBAM assessment or proposes an enforceable temporary measure under Article 30(7); assume no exemption before an official act.

items.title_zh: 土耳其贸易部长：前三季对欧钢铁出口下降6.7%，对非欧盟市场增长10%
items.title_en: Türkiye says nine-month steel exports to the EU fell 6.7% while non-EU shipments rose 10%
items.title_original: Turkish Trade Minister slams tighter EU steel quotas as exports fall 6.7%
items.summary_zh: 土耳其贸易部长Ömer Bolat在Steel Networking Summits 2026表示，2026年1—9月土耳其对欧盟的CBAM覆盖钢铁产品出口同比下降1.7%，全部钢铁出口下降6.7%，对欧盟以外市场出口增长10%；欧盟仍占土耳其钢铁出口的42.3%。他把变化与欧盟钢铁配额自7月1日起收紧及CBAM正式期实施并列讨论，并批评单边限制增加成本。官方讲话还称，土耳其2025年粗钢产量38.1百万吨，钢材出口额171亿美元，约78%的产能采用废钢电弧炉，电炉粗钢产量27.5百万吨、废钢进口18.8百万吨。这是土耳其政府对贸易流向和政策压力的判断，不是欧盟修改配额、CBAM减免或新增税率的决定。
items.summary_en: Trade Minister Ömer Bolat said Türkiye's January–September 2026 exports of CBAM-covered steel products to the EU fell 1.7%, total iron and steel exports to the EU fell 6.7%, and non-EU shipments rose 10%; the EU still represented 42.3% of Turkish steel exports. He linked the pressure to tighter EU quotas and definitive CBAM and criticised unilateral restrictions. The ministry also reported 38.1Mt of 2025 crude steel output, $17.1bn of steel exports, 78% scrap-EAF capacity, 27.5Mt EAF output and 18.8Mt scrap imports. This is a Turkish government trade assessment, not a new EU rule or exemption.
items.impact_zh: 土耳其钢材对欧受限并向非欧盟市场转移，可能加剧中东、北非、英国及其他第三国市场的竞价和贸易转移风险；但现有数据不能证明这些增量全部流向中国企业的目标市场。中国钢厂应按产品和目的地监测土耳其报价、到货量及贸易救济案件，同时比较废钢电炉路线的核证排放优势。不能把土耳其部长的批评当作欧盟将给予豁免或调整CBAM的信号。
items.impact_en: Diversion from the EU may intensify competition in third-country markets, but the data do not show where all additional shipments went. Chinese exporters should monitor Turkish offers and arrivals by product and destination, trade-remedy exposure and verified EAF emissions. The minister's criticism is not evidence of an EU exemption or CBAM amendment.

items.coverage: 2026-10-30已通读Türkiye Today全文，并以土耳其贸易部官方讲话核对1.7%、6.7%、10%、42.3%、38.1百万吨、171亿美元、78%、27.5百万吨和18.8百万吨等数字。欧盟措施的法律状态另以Regulation (EU) 2026/1384核对；未获得按HS/CN和目的国拆分的土耳其海关明细，不能判断具体产品转移量。
items.follow_up: 跟踪欧盟按产品和原产地的配额使用、土耳其月度出口流向及第三国贸易救济；只有出现正式欧盟文本时才更新法律状态。

items.title_zh: 韩国庆尚南道研讨制造业应对CBAM：强调碳数据与企业现场支持
items.title_en: South Gyeongsang forum highlights carbon data and practical CBAM support for manufacturers
items.title_original: South Korea forum urges on-site support as CBAM threatens Gyeongnam exports - CHOSUNBIZ
items.summary_zh: 韩国国家气候危机应对委员会与庆尚南道于10月26日在昌原举办第三次区域论坛，约200名政府、产业、学术和专家代表讨论全球碳监管、当地制造业转型和碳竞争力。韩国政府原始新闻稿显示，议题包括庆尚南道制造业EU CBAM应对、全球CBAM与韩国政策、世亚昌原特殊钢的低碳转型实践、出口竞争力以及企业碳数据利用。地方政府表示将加强机构协作并扩大企业可实际获得的支持。该活动是政策讨论和支持方向，不是新增税率、补贴方案或具有约束力的合规规则。
items.summary_en: South Korea's National Climate Crisis Response Commission and South Gyeongsang Province held their third regional forum in Changwon on 26 October, with about 200 government, industry, academic and expert participants. The official release lists sessions on EU CBAM strategy for regional manufacturing, global and Korean policy trends, SeAH Changwon Integrated Special Steel's transition, export competitiveness and corporate carbon data. Authorities promised stronger coordination and practical support. This is a policy forum and support direction, not a new duty, subsidy programme or binding compliance rule.
items.impact_zh: 对向欧盟供应钢铁、机械和金属制品的中国企业，这一消息本身不改变CBAM义务，但反映韩国同类出口商正把装置排放、核查、产品碳数据和地方支持结合起来。中国钢厂可据此检查与下游客户的数据接口和核查准备，但不应把论坛表态当作韩国已经推出具体补贴，亦不能据新闻推导产品税额或竞争成本。
items.impact_en: The forum does not change CBAM obligations but shows Korean competitors integrating installation emissions, verification, product data and local support. Chinese suppliers should test data interfaces and verification readiness without assuming a concrete Korean subsidy or inferring product-level costs.

items.follow_up: 关注韩国国家气候危机应对委员会、庆尚南道及产业主管部门是否把论坛方向转化为具名支持项目、申请条件或资金安排；届时另行核验正式文件。

items.title_zh: 印度商务部长批评欧盟钢铁限制与CBAM：属于谈判立场，不是规则变更
items.title_en: India's commerce minister criticises EU steel curbs and CBAM; remarks do not change the rules
items.title_original: 'EU shooting itself in the foot': Piyush Goyal warns Europe over CBAM, import duty
items.summary_zh: 印度商务与工业部长皮尤什·戈亚尔（Piyush Goyal）在10月22日柏林全球对话上批评欧盟钢铁进口限制、CBAM及其他监管要求，认为这些措施会推高钢、铝、水泥及基础设施成本，削弱欧洲竞争力，并可能引发贸易伙伴的对等措施。他同时强调印度希望获得欧洲电解槽等技术以发展绿氢和绿色钢铁。印度政府官方访问预告确认了戈亚尔10月22日至24日在柏林参加该对话及讨论印欧FTA市场准入，但没有宣布CBAM豁免、钢铁配额调整或新关税决定。
items.summary_en: India's Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal criticised EU steel import restrictions, CBAM and other regulatory requirements at the Berlin Global Dialogue on 22 October, arguing that they could raise steel, aluminium, cement and infrastructure costs, weaken European competitiveness and invite reciprocal measures. He also sought European technology for green hydrogen and green steel. India's official visit notice confirms his Berlin participation and India-EU FTA market-access discussions, but announces no CBAM exemption, quota change or new tariff decision.
items.impact_zh: 这是印度政府的公开政策立场和谈判信号，不改变中国钢材现行欧盟配额、50%超配额税或CBAM义务。中国出口商不应据此假定印度将获得豁免、欧盟会撤回措施，或印欧FTA会自动改变中国产品待遇。应继续按现行CN、原产地、配额和排放规则报价，同时跟踪印欧FTA是否形成针对印度钢材的可执行安排及其对欧盟市场竞争格局的影响。
items.impact_en: This is an Indian policy and negotiating position, not a change to EU treatment of Chinese steel. Chinese exporters should not assume an Indian exemption, EU withdrawal or automatic effect from an India-EU FTA. Continue pricing under current CN, origin, quota and emissions rules, while monitoring any enforceable India-specific outcome and its competitive effect in the EU market.

items.summary_en: SMM reported on 22 October that major Nordic mills offered HRC for February-March 2027 delivery at EUR 800-830/t DDP; Northwest European HRC was assessed at EUR 740/t EXW and Italian HRC at EUR 743/t EXW, down EUR 1. It attributed weak restocking to soft end demand, high inventories and the working-capital effect of CBAM certificate-balance requirements. The Commission's CBAM Registry page confirms tools for monitoring the '50% rule', but SMM's description of pre-purchasing and freezing 50% of annual obligations is a media characterisation, not a substitute for the legal quarterly account-balance calculation.
items.impact_zh: 这是一份市场报价与采购情绪报告，不是官方基准价格或新法规。对中国热卷出口商而言，欧盟买方可能把CBAM证书持有和融资成本计入报价、付款条件或采购节奏；企业应给客户提供可核查的实际排放资料，并分别测算EXW/DDP、配额和CBAM资金成本。不得把800—830欧元/吨视为全欧统一成交价，也不得据此给中国订单加上固定“50%融资附加费”。
items.impact_en: This is a market and sentiment report, not an official benchmark or new law. EU buyers may incorporate CBAM certificate holdings and financing costs into quotations, payment terms or purchasing schedules. Chinese HRC exporters should provide verifiable actual-emissions data and model EXW/DDP, quota and CBAM working-capital effects separately. Do not treat EUR 800-830/t as a Europe-wide transaction price or add a fixed '50% financing surcharge' to Chinese orders.

items.summary_zh: 这是一篇香港贸发局行业解读，并非新法规。文章梳理英国CBAM自2027年1月1日起适用于铝、水泥、化肥、氢及钢铁五个行业；法律责任由英国进口商承担，但境外生产商和香港贸易商需要提供产品与生产装置对应关系、净重、实际隐含排放及已支付碳价等证据，否则进口商可能使用默认值计税。英国进口商在过去12个月或未来30日内受管商品净重达到50,000英镑价值门槛时须注册；2027年首个年度申报期的申报和付款截止日为2028年5月31日，此后改为季度申报。英国政府当前合格碳定价制度名单包含中国全国碳排放权交易市场，但这不等于自动或足额减免：可抵扣金额取决于实际有效碳价及可核验证据，免费配额、补贴或返还会降低可主张金额。
items.summary_en: This is an HKTDC industry explainer, not a new legal measure. It outlines the UK CBAM starting on 1 January 2027 for aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen and iron and steel. UK importers bear the legal liability, but overseas producers and Hong Kong traders will need product-to-installation links, net mass, verified embedded-emissions data and evidence of carbon prices actually paid; otherwise defaults may be used. Registration applies when relevant imports cross the GBP 50,000 value threshold over the relevant look-back or forward-looking test. The first 2027 return and payment are due on 31 May 2028, followed by quarterly periods. The current UK qualifying-schemes list includes the China National ETS, but relief is not automatic or necessarily full: it depends on the effective price and verified evidence, and is reduced by free allocation, subsidies or rebates.
items.impact_zh: 对向英国出口钢铁、经香港转口或由香港贸易商组织交易的中国企业，重点不是仅向英国客户提供一个企业平均排放数，而是尽快按8位商品编码、生产企业和具体装置建立可追溯数据包，保存净重、实际直接/间接排放边界、核证文件及中国全国碳市场实际支付碳价证明，并在销售合同中明确数据提供、第三方核证、默认值风险、税负转嫁和更正责任。中国全国碳市场被列入合格制度只提供申请减免的制度入口，不能据此在报价中预设固定抵扣额；应由英国进口商依据实际有效碳价和证据申报。英国与欧盟CBAM的申报、价格和认可机制不同，不能直接共用税额结论。
items.impact_en: Chinese steel producers exporting to the UK, including Hong Kong-routed trades, should build traceable data packs by 8-digit commodity code, producer and installation rather than provide only a company-wide average. Retain net mass, boundary-consistent direct and indirect emissions data, verification records and evidence of carbon prices effectively paid under China's national ETS, and allocate data, verification, default-value, pass-through and correction risks in contracts. Inclusion of China's ETS on the qualifying-schemes list creates a route to claim relief but does not justify assuming a fixed credit in pricing; the UK importer must substantiate the effective price. UK and EU CBAM rules remain separate.

items.title_zh: 南非研究：CBAM冲击取决于产品排放强度与进口价格，不宜只看国家平均值
items.title_en: South African study says CBAM exposure depends on product emissions and import prices, not country averages alone
items.title_original: LAWRENCE EDWARDS AND NICOLA WILLS | The CBAM wake-up call: decarbonisation is now an export survival issue
items.summary_zh: Business Day刊发开普敦大学Lawrence Edwards与Nicola Wills的评论，基于ERSA产品层面局部均衡研究。作者指出，同类产品的排放强度可在国家和企业间显著不同，固定的每吨碳成本对低价、高排放产品造成的价格涨幅更大。其南非情景以80欧元/吨CO₂e并计入直接与间接排放时，模拟钢铁平均欧盟进口价格上升约31%；直接排放情景下南非钢铁进口量约降48%，纳入间接排放后约降76%。这些是南非模型结果，不是对中国产品的税额或销量预测。
items.summary_en: Business Day published commentary by UCT researchers Lawrence Edwards and Nicola Wills based on an ERSA product-level partial-equilibrium study. They argue that emissions vary across products and firms, while a fixed carbon cost causes a larger percentage price increase for cheaper, emissions-intensive goods. In their South African scenario using EUR 80/tCO2e and both direct and indirect emissions, the model raises average EU import prices for iron and steel by about 31%; estimated South African steel imports fall about 48% with direct emissions only and 76% when indirect emissions are included. These are South African model results, not Chinese duty or volume forecasts.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂的可用启示是，应按产品、装置和工艺准备实际排放数据，并把产品单价、排放强度和客户替代弹性一起纳入欧盟报价情景；提升产品附加值可以降低固定碳成本占售价的比例。但不得把文中的31%、48%或76%直接套用于中国订单。若欧盟未来正式纳入更多间接排放，应再依据最终法规、CN范围、实际排放和届时EU ETS价格重算。
items.impact_en: For Chinese mills, the useful lesson is to model EU quotations using product-, installation- and process-level verified emissions together with unit value and demand substitution. Higher-value products may reduce the carbon charge as a share of price. Do not apply the article's 31%, 48% or 76% South African estimates to Chinese orders. Recalculate only against final EU rules, CN scope, actual emissions and the relevant ETS price if indirect-emissions coverage changes.

items.title_en: South Korea preliminarily finds injury from Chinese alloy-steel bars; provisional duties await finance-ministry action
items.title_original: China Steel Bar Duties Near, Squeezing Small Forging Firms
items.summary_zh: 韩国贸易委员会于2026年9月17日第477次会议对中国合金钢棒作出倾销和产业损害肯定性初裁，并建议财政经济部门在调查期间征收25.08%—27.96%的临时反倾销税。涉案棒材用于汽车、工程机械、造船、轴承和工业机械零部件；申请人为世亚贝斯特与世亚昌原特殊钢，调查对象包括中国大冶、江苏永钢和金腾三组供应商。委员会预计于2027年2月作出终裁。该初裁及建议不等同于临时税已经生效。
items.summary_en: At its 477th meeting on 17 September 2026, the Korea Trade Commission made an affirmative preliminary dumping and injury determination on alloy-steel bars from China and recommended provisional anti-dumping duties of 25.08%–27.96% during the investigation. The bars are used in automotive, construction-equipment, shipbuilding, bearing and industrial-machinery parts. SeAH Besteel and SeAH Changwon Special Steel filed the petition; the investigated supplier groups include Daye, Jiangsu Yonggang and Jinteng. A final determination is planned for February 2027. The preliminary finding and recommendation do not by themselves put provisional duties into force.
items.impact_zh: 对韩出口合金钢棒的中国生产商和贸易商应立即按韩国书面产品范围核对牌号、制造方式、HSK编码、生产商—出口商组合及关联企业，并保存内销、对韩销售、成本和产能数据以应对后续核查。报价和到港安排不得直接套用媒体列示的企业税率；只有韩国财政部门发布实施公告后，才能确认临时税的生效日、征收期和报关适用税率。同步跟踪2027年2月终裁节点。
items.impact_en: Chinese producers and traders exporting alloy-steel bars to Korea should immediately map grades, manufacturing method, HSK codes, producer-exporter combinations and affiliates against the written scope, and preserve home-market sales, Korean sales, cost and capacity data for the continuing investigation. Do not apply media-reported company rates to quotations or arrivals until the Korean finance authority publishes an implementing notice confirming the effective date, collection period and entry rate. Monitor the planned February 2027 final determination.

items.title_original: Beijing Shougang to Boost Stake in Electrical Steel Unit for Up to 3 Billion Yuan
items.summary_zh: 首钢股份公告编号2026-047显示，公司拟以自有及自筹资金，按5.1269元/股受让首钢智新11家股东合计587,911,257股，占首钢智新总股本19.60%，预计总价不超过30.15亿元。若按拟议范围完成，首钢股份持股比例将由66.23%升至85.83%，仍为控股股东。九届八次董事会已于2026年10月15日通过，关联董事回避表决；交易构成关联交易、不构成重大资产重组，仍须2026年11月3日临时股东会批准，最终股份数量和价款还取决于实际签署协议。
items.summary_en: Announcement No. 2026-047 says Shougang Co. proposes to acquire 587,911,257 shares in Shougang Zhixin from 11 shareholders at CNY 5.1269 per share, representing 19.60% of the subsidiary, for up to CNY 3.015 billion using internal and raised funds. If completed as proposed, its stake would rise from 66.23% to 85.83%. The board approved the related-party transaction on 15 October 2026 with related directors abstaining; it is not a major asset restructuring but still requires approval at the extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 3 November. Final shares and consideration depend on executed agreements.
items.impact_zh: 这项交易首先是控股权和治理结构调整，不等同于新增30.15亿元电工钢产能，也不会直接改变出口关税、CBAM或产品认证。若获批并完成，少数股东权益下降、决策权进一步集中，可能有利于高端取向及无取向电工钢研发、产能升级和全产业链协同；但具体产量、产品组合、资本开支和客户供货变化仍须以后续项目及经营公告为准。业务团队应在11月3日后核对股东会结果及最终协议，再更新对客户的产能和供应判断。
items.impact_en: This is primarily a control and governance transaction, not CNY 3.015 billion of new electrical-steel capacity, and it does not directly change tariffs, CBAM treatment or product approvals. If approved and completed, greater control may support R&D, capacity upgrades and value-chain coordination in high-grade grain-oriented and non-oriented electrical steel, but output, product mix, capex and customer-supply effects require later operating disclosures. Recheck the shareholder vote and final agreements after 3 November before changing customer-facing capacity or supply assumptions.

items.summary_zh: OR10月19日评论以中国粗钢及建筑需求下降、澳矿供给扩张为背景，质疑仅靠绿铁叙事即可消化供给增量。其判断涉及氢电成本、绿铁溢价、长期客户和项目规模，属于商业评论。文中跨财年澳大利亚收入预测及合作备忘录未在本条独立核验，不把预测下降额写成已发生损失。
items.summary_en: The 19 October commentary questions whether green iron alone can absorb supply growth amid weaker Chinese steel demand. Its commercial argument concerns hydrogen/power costs, premiums, customers and scale; fiscal-year forecasts and a cited memorandum were not independently verified here.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂评估澳洲绿铁采购时应核对氢源、电价、金属化率、运费、长期包销与年度核查数据。试点产出、宣布合作和达产商业供应是不同阶段，不能单凭文章叙事锁定供应量或碳成本优势。
items.impact_en: Check hydrogen supply, power, metallisation, freight, offtake and verified annual emissions. A pilot or cooperation announcement is distinct from fully operational supply.

items.summary_zh: S&P10月16日比较欧委会、理事会和议会的下游扩围方案：按其GTA口径，拟议产品对应2025年进口额超过2550亿美元，约24%金额涉及三方共同提出的产品，其余仍有分歧。机械、电气、车辆及金属制品有交集，医疗器械、涡轮机等不同；这是媒体方案比较和贸易暴露测算，并非新增确定税基。
items.summary_en: S&P’s 16 October comparison estimates over US$255bn of 2025 imports in proposed goods, with 24% of trade value common to all three institutional lists. Machinery, vehicles and metal goods overlap; medical equipment and turbines differ. These are media trade-exposure estimates, not an adopted tax base.
items.impact_zh: 中国出口商可分“各方案交集”和“仍有争议”建立编码观察表，但即使交集产品也须等待最终通过文本。不要把2550亿美元当作税额或全部已纳入CBAM的贸易。
items.impact_en: Track common and contested CN codes, then confirm the final adopted text. Trade exposure is not a tax bill or proof of current coverage.

items.summary_en: Government Courier issue 215, page 20, publishes decision AD-609/2026/441-01 of 12 October, effective on publication on 13 October. It cancels the Chinese measure and its Malaysian extension. Coverage is limited to described screws, bolts and nuts under ex7318156890, ex7318158290, ex7318158890, ex7318159590, ex7318169290 and ex7318169990, subject to dimensions and exclusions.
items.impact_zh: 中国紧固件企业应按型号、直径和乌克兰10位编码让进口商核对适用性，更新撤销该项反倾销税后的报价。其他进口税、原产地、海关及制裁要求仍须分别满足；不得把撤销特定措施理解为全部税费为零。

items.summary_zh: SMM10月16日报道，一些第三国供应商难以取得板坯、生铁等前体的核查数据，买方因默认值和配额风险对一季度订单趋谨慎。其当日报价为西北欧热卷€740/吨EXW、意大利€742/吨EXW，部分一二季度到货进口报价€780—800/吨DDP；这些为特定时点市场观察，不是官方价格或通用税差。
items.summary_en: The 16 October report links slab/pig-iron verification gaps and quota risks to cautious Q1 buying. Quoted domestic prices were €740/t EXW in northwest Europe and €742/t in Italy, versus selected import offers of €780–800/t DDP. These are dated market observations, not official prices or a universal carbon-tax spread.

items.impact_en: Close precursor-data gaps and specify quota, verification and carbon-cost risks in contracts. EXW, CFR and DDP quotations are not directly comparable tax measures.
